name: 3x3 RGB 216-bit saved-input to 72-bit grayscale, shared core (numeric-compatibility)

spec.architecture: 216 persistent input bits, one all-input state barrier, finite nine-token FIFO controller, thermometer selector, one shared stateless grayscale core, 72 conditional output-state bits
spec.pixel_order: row-major, L1 is top-left, L9 is bottom-right
spec.output_encoding: nine unsigned 8-bit grayscale pixels in row-major order
spec.rounding: nearest integer; exact half rounds up
spec.color_processing: integer approximation on supplied encoded RGB bytes; no gamma decoding or color-space conversion
spec.input_protocol: Each frame supplies every X0..X215 exactly once, in one send or disjoint partial sends. Execution may occur between sends. Send no bit of the next frame until the current complete frame FIFO has drained. No overlapping frames or repeated Xi within an incomplete frame. Drain the two initialization events before observing a frame.
spec.incomplete_frame: Save received bits, retain unsent input-state bits and all previous output values. No new Tick or grayscale output publication occurs until all 216 inputs arrive. Reset may discard an incomplete frame.
spec.output_validity: Each Yi publishes nine times per complete frame, once per shared-core round, including unchanged values. Only the selected pixel output registers change q. Intermediate publications are not a complete-frame result. Read the final 72-bit output only after a complete frame has supplied all 216 inputs and the FIFO has drained.
spec.state_initialization: The eight selector thresholds start at 1; all other state q bits start at 0. Bootstrap and clock execute once on initialization, filling the nine token clock slots without any grayscale output publication.
spec.state_update: Only Xi writes its corresponding saved input q. The feedback loop reads those states without modifying them. Output q is conditionally overwritten in its corresponding pixel round and persists across frames.

execution.idle_cache: Exactly one clock arrival remains in each of the nine token nodes; every other arrival cache is empty. These nine clock slots are intentionally retained for the next frame.
ordering_invariants: Each storage numeric ID is lower than frame_seed, so all storage writes execute before the all-X barrier.
selector_wrap sorts before thresholds in s8..s1 order; every selector state sorts before selected_inputs.
Every output_state sorts before core_done; core_done requires all eight stateless core output sources.
execution.termination: At round r=1..9, only token nodes T[r-1]..T8 have a merge arrival. Clock C consumes those arrivals and those token nodes publish once, replenishing only M[r]..M8. T8 starts one shared-core round, whose completion publishes the next C. Thus the active suffix loses one token per round. After round 9 no merge arrivals remain; C is cached but cannot enqueue any token node, and the FIFO drains. The next frame seeds all nine merge arrivals again.

optimization.method: One core reused nine times; three-node nonconstant full adders; safe JK-expression inlining; 24 single-node nine-way input selectors; single-node conditional output writes; finite token control; all-X FIFO barrier replaces 216 separate completion nodes.

hash_contract: md5 = lowercase MD5 of UTF-8 recursively key-sorted JSON of {nodes, initial_q, q_y, spec}; array order retained
